ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Black and Asian American Literature and History. This course examines the shifting literary and historical representations of African Americans and Asian Americans. Starting with the period of post-emancipation and the migration of Asian labor in the rise of U.S. capitalism and ending in the late twentieth century, we will read Asian American and African American novels in their historical contexts that prompt a comparative understanding race and labor in the United States. Meets with AFRO 298, CRN 54897; ENG 274, CRN 41001; and HIST 199, CRN 41773.
